summary: Frontend-only testing of PosePilot Expo React Native camera app. Core functionality works but CRITICAL auto-capture timing bug prevents user interaction. Camera screen loads correctly with all HUD elements, pose selection works, manual capture works, navigation works. Main issue: auto-capture fires within 500ms of camera load (instead of ~5s as designed), creating infinite capture loop.

ui_bugs.issue: Toggle buttons (preview-mode-before/after) are outside viewport on mobile (375x667), cannot be clicked
Pose illustration SVGs not rendering in library cards (black boxes shown instead of pose skeletons)

integration_issues.issue: CRITICAL: Auto-capture fires within 500ms of camera screen loading instead of ~5s. Simulated detector starts with 95% match score, reaches 85% threshold almost immediately. Users cannot interact with camera before being auto-captured to preview. Creates infinite loop: camera loads → auto-capture at 500ms → preview → camera continues running in background → auto-capture again at 3s → new preview. Multiple captures created every 3 seconds.
integration_issues.root_cause: Simulated detector's initial pose (shiftedInitialPose) is only 5% offset from target, resulting in 95% match immediately. Auto-capture enabled by default with no grace period.
reproduction_steps: 4. Camera detection loop continues in background

context_for_next_testing_agent: Auto-capture bug is the main blocker. To test effectively: (1) Navigate directly to /camera, (2) Immediately click toggle-auto to disable auto-capture within 200ms, (3) Then test other features. Or wait for main agent to fix the grace period issue. All other features (pose selection, library, gallery, preview, settings) work correctly when auto-capture is disabled.
rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE: Simulated detector convergence timing mismatch. DESIGN INTENT: Score should ramp from ~30 to 90+ over ~5 seconds, giving users time to adjust pose. ACTUAL BEHAVIOR: Detector starts at 95% match (shiftedInitialPose is too similar to target), reaches 85% threshold within 500ms. CONTRIBUTING FACTORS: (1) No grace period after camera mount, (2) Auto-capture enabled by default, (3) Initial pose offset too small (5% vs needed ~40-50% for realistic progression). IMPACT: Users cannot interact with camera before auto-capture fires. Camera continues running after navigation, creating infinite capture loop. MITIGATION: Add 3-5s grace period OR increase initial pose offset OR disable auto-capture by default.
